messages:
dana: Publish failed for release candidate rc-2026-03-21-01: manifest push aborted, missing blob sha256:bb33...fee1 when writing to ecr-us-east-1.

deploy-bot: publish blocked: 422 Manifest validation error - referenced blob not found in destination (ecr://redwood-staging/us-east-1). See job https://ci.internal/builds/98765

kevin: any idea if this is a CI upload problem or a downstream fetch error?

dana: CI logs show the upload step succeeded to the builder bucket, but deploy job got 404 on HEAD when streaming to ECR mirror service. Suspect mirror service token rotated mid-flight.

infra: checking mirror-worker logs now. If token refresh coincided with push we could have seen transient 401/403 that led to incomplete blob.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-0428 - staging publish interrupted by mirror auth error. Pager duty notified.

kevin: short-term mitigation: lock staging tag to current digest (sha256:de12...aabb) so canary remains stable. Then plan republish with new object path and explicit `--no-cache` so origin fetches fresh.

deploy-bot: canary-hold requested by kevin: `deploy-bot canary-hold staging`. Reply `approve` to confirm.

dana: approve. Add a note to release notes: "staging: temporarily pinned to previous digest while investigating mirror auth/replication; republish scheduled in maintenance window."

infra: mirror logs show `oauth: token refresh - expired at 2026-03-21T00:59:30Z` and `http/1.1 403 Forbidden` during blob PUT. INFRA-5134 opened to extend refresh window and add retries.

security: we will need to re-run cosign attestation after republish. Leave audit trail in the ticket.

kevin: fallback if GC removed source blob: retag previous digest to `staging-temp-1749802468` and run full canary on that tag. If republish succeeds, swap tags and revoke temp. Make sure to re-sign on swap.

dana: timeline: (1) pin staging now. (2) infra applies short GC hold for prefix `staging/2026-03-21/` (INFRA-5135). (3) mirror token patch + backoff retries rolled in 00:30 UTC maintenance. (4) republish under `staging/2026-03-21-repush-1749802468` in the 01:00 UTC change window with `--re-sign`. (5) canary verification then rotate tag.

infra: GC hold requested; if object already deleted we will notify and coordinate retag path. Also adding tighter monitoring for mirror-worker 4xx rates.

deploy-bot: deploy summary: staging pinned -> sha256:de12...aabb; pending republish and attestation.

kevin: I'll update the release notes and post a short blurb to #platform-alerts so consumers know about the temporary pin.

dana: thanks all. I'll run the republish once INFRA confirms token refresh patch is live.
